You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and executing both manual and automated testing strategies, working closely with development teams to foster a strong quality-driven culture from the ground up. You will perform end-to-end testing across backend integrations, frontend, and mobile. This is an opportunity to work with different frameworks. You will face the challenge of handling multiple tasks and balancing different domains within a team that is committed to supporting your growth. You will also be involved in application testing and in developing automated tests, contributing to the creation of effective strategies to implement automation across various areas of the product. Your Responsibilities Take full ownership of product quality and reliability, ensuring seamless performance across all features. Develop and maintain automated UI tests using TypeScript and Playwright to enhance frontend reliability. Design and execute API tests using Jest, ensuring robust backend validation. Work closely with development teams to identify, prevent, and resolve quality issues early in the development cycle. Lead test planning and risk assessments, ensuring that releases are stable, secure, and ready for production. Continuously improve QA processes, tools, and methodologies, helping to evolve our testing framework in an agile environment. Your Experience 4+ years of experience as a QA Automation Engineer or SDET, with a solid track record in delivering high‑quality automated testing solutions. Deep understanding of software testing principles, QA methodologies, and best practices, including strong attention to detail in both documentation and test execution. Hands‑on experience with web automation, preferably using Playwright with JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience with API testing and API automation, ideally using Jest or similar testing frameworks. Good knowledge of CI/CD pipelines - Azure DevOps/Gitlab/Jenkins or other, including test automation integration, and familiarity with version control systems such as Git. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying quality gaps and proposing improvements. Effective communication skills and a collaborative working style when partnering with developers, product managers, and cross‑functional teams. Experience using AI‑powered tools (e.g., for test generation, code assistance, debugging, exploratory testing, or automation optimization) is considered a strong plus.
